comment: The single place an SDK's tier is declared. CI derives its gating from
this file, and docs/sdk-tiers.md states the promise each tier carries.
Change a tier here and nowhere else.
core: gated in CI on every push. A defect here blocks a release. The
parity promise is real: the behavior vectors run, the SDK's own suite
runs, and for backend SDKs the hermetic acceptance runs.
community: must pass the behavior vectors, does not block a release. A
unmaintained: shipped, not gated, no promise. Listed so the cost is
